name: com.originalpictures/mcp
title: Original Pictures
description: Sign media with C2PA Content Credentials and verify its declared origin.

environmentVariables.name: ORIGINALPICTURES_MCP_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool scope allowlist. No tool is enabled until it is listed here; sign:write and verify:write enable the billable tools.

environmentVariables.name: ORIGINALPICTURES_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Original Pictures API origin. Defaults to https://api.originalpictures.com.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by an Original Pictures API key (opk_...). Use a dedicated key with only the scopes the client needs; sign:write and verify:write enable the billable tools.
